source: CT Law Articles 34 & 55 · Ministerial Decision No. 97 of 2023
headline: SMALL COMPANY?
TRANSFER PRICING

blocks.text: Transfer pricing is only for big multinationals.

items: **Arm's length** applies to every deal with related parties and connected persons, at any size
**Master and local files** only if your revenue is **AED 200 million+** or your group's is **AED 3.15 billion+**
Below that, keep **evidence of market prices**. The FTA can still ask for it
